correctness.rationale: The constant mode cancels for both connected graphs. On the common mean-zero space the spectra are positive, and differentiation gives MZ+ZN=I for the convergent cross integral; traces are basis invariant. Independently derived the triangle cross trace using centered 2×2 operators X=M−αI and Y=N−βI, with α=tr(M)/2, β=tr(N)/2, X²=x²I, Y²=y²I and d=tr(XY)/2. For H=α+β and R=H²−x²−y², integration of the hyperbolic-function expansions gives tr(Z)=2H(R+2d)/(R²−4x²y²), with the repeated-eigenvalue cases by continuity. Substitution and exact cross multiplication matched the actual expanded P/D, both with 30 positive monomials, so the difference has sign b−a for every positive weight triple, including equality at a=b. Vertex relabeling covers all pairs. Independent rational solves for (100,10,11,11) matched the four printed fractions and E₂<E₁<E₃<E₀; exact E₁−E₂ is 18976950041406901787484663/11750543650483124820155055200. The deleted edge is (2,3) of weight 11. Triangles are the only smaller simple cycles, so four is sharp.
